name: A DRV pension and a Rürup pension of a German national living in Italy (limited tax liability)
workings: The treaty gives Italy the Rürup pension (Art. 18), with a warning to set its taxedIn to residence; Germany taxes the DRV pension (Art. 19(4)): 17,552.256 − 102 = 17,450.256

§1 Abs. 3 on what Germany sees: the Rürup pension as German law counts it, 86% × 16,000 = 13,760, isn't taxed in Germany. 17,450.256 is less than 90% of 31,210.256 and 13,760 is more than the 12,348 basic allowance, so no resident treatment
Limited tax liability (§50 Abs. 1 Satz 2): the tariff on the taxable income plus the basic allowance, no special expenses: T(29,798.256) = 4,160.324755; no Soli
Both exempt amounts are fixed in the state: 14% × 20,409.60 = 2,857.344 and 14% × 16,000 = 2,240
